animation.sample: 2s linear -1s infinite alternate both running move

mask.sample: linear-gradient(black, transparent) center / 50% auto no-repeat border-box alpha

scrolling.parser: Typed snap axes/align/stop, auto/smooth, per-axis overscroll, physical/logical padding/margin and scrollbar color/width; gutters unsupported.
scrolling.cascade: Atomic shorthands, variables, wide/rollback; scrollbar color inherited, width non-inherited.
scrolling.computed: Contextual lengths with snapport-relative padding percentages; typed enums.
scrolling.used: Retained document scroll motion, shared spatial sticky translations, gesture-end snapping, nested fragment reveal, overlay styled scrollbar input. Finite UA policies documented in scrolling.md; no WPT claim.

animation.parser: Bounded typed timing/effect lists, atomic shorthands; linear() and timeline-scope excluded.
animation.cascade: Normal typed/variable shorthand machinery; animations below important, transitions above important.
animation.computed: Native document timing; no JS bindings.
animation.used: Frame samples before fonts/layout/paint; scroll/view timing from completed geometry.

effects.parser: Bounded typed 2D/3D functions, CSS box origins, numeric/filter lists, basic shapes, mask image/gradient and layer lists. SVG references/path()/rounded inset and extended gradients are rejected.
effects.cascade: Generated longhands, CSS-wide rollback, all and pending variables use the normal cascade; effect-created stacking contexts stop z-index escape.
effects.computed: Selected-font, viewport and container units computed with finite math; box percentages retained. Independent translate/rotate/scale precede transform.
effects.used: Post-layout finite plane projection/inverse input; transparent RGBA effect groups, projected device-space filters/backdrop, W3C blend modes, local-policy masks and center-tested shapes with nearest source sampling. No intersecting preserve-3d surfaces, full backdrop-root/kernel-space/SVG masking or GPU/color-management claim.

typography.parser: Typed finite Text/Decoration/Fonts/Lists grammars; no text-wrap balance/pretty, reversed() counter-reset, speak-as or SVG font execution.
typography.cascade: CSS-wide, variables and rollback through generated property dispatch; decorations establish independent non-inherited sources; counters are document-order scoped.
typography.computed: Typed keywords, lengths, canonical sorted OpenType settings, counter operations and generated text; transformed text retains source mapping.
typography.used: Grapheme-safe Text wrapping and justification, English-US licensed hyphenation, Unicode language casing, native decoration strokes, real variable/color font masks and scoped list markers/counter formats. Finite limits and unsupported formats diagnosed; no full spec/WPT claim.

aspect-ratio.parser: Finite nonnegative ratios, auto and auto ratio in either order; negative/duplicate/interleaved tokens rejected. Degenerate zero ratios behave as auto; ratio math and unrepresentable ratios are rejected.
aspect-ratio.computed: Auto flag and finite preferred ratio.
aspect-ratio.used: Content/border-box auto-axis transfer, content-box auto-ratio transfer, replaced natural ratio precedence and non-scrollable ratio-dependent automatic content minimums; two explicit axes remain independent. Replaced fallback dimensions do not invent a natural ratio. Min/max clamps may break an impossible ratio; full bidirectional constraint transfer and advanced cyclic/fragmented sizing remain partial; no animation.

object-fit.parser: fill, contain, cover, none and scale-down.
object-fit.used: Actual decoded bitmap fitting, clipped to the replaced content box.

object-position.parser: One to four physical position tokens with lengths, percentages and edge offsets; logical position keywords absent.
object-position.used: Physical positioned bitmap rectangle inside the content clip, never changes box or hit geometry; native horizontal/vertical flow uses the same crop and software sampling.

bidi.cascade: Non-inherited; excluded from all; CSS-wide and rollback.
bidi.computed: Typed paragraph and inline embedding/isolation controls, including HTML dir/auto, bdi and bdo defaults.
bidi.used: Bounded UAX9 paragraph levels, CSS scopes reopened at paragraph breaks, per-line L1/L2 ordering and resolved-direction shaping with cluster/owner identity. No external WPT/conformance gate.

writing.cascade: Inherited; resolved before logical property mapping.
writing.computed: Logical and physical candidates compete in shared cascade buckets, including variables, inherit and rollback.
writing.used: Native inline/block axes, vertical columns, orthogonal blocks/atomic inlines, flex/grid allocation, floats and table cells. Complex parent/empty margin collapse, orthogonal baseline groups and fragmentation remain partial; no full WPT gate.

orientation.computed: UAX50 orientation (unicode-vo revision-17 data); upright uses LTR direction.
orientation.used: TTB OpenType vert/vrt2 glyphs and vertical advances; mixed Latin rotates individual masks, Tr uses substituted upright or rotated fallback. No text-combine-upright, full modern UAX50 data or advanced script baselines.

float.parser: none, left, right, inline-start and inline-end.
float.cascade: Non-inherited; CSS-wide/var/rollback; ignored on flex/grid items.
float.computed: Logical inline sides resolve by direction; blockification; absolute/fixed compute none.
float.used: Source-ordered logical-axis exclusions, native float children, line opportunities and shrink-to-fit. Complex shared vertical BFC exclusions remain partial; no shape-outside or pagination.

clear.parser: none, left, right, both, inline-start and inline-end.
clear.computed: Logical inline sides resolve by direction.
clear.used: Clearance past earlier float block extents in horizontal or vertical flow. Complex vertical parent/empty collapse and shared BFC interactions remain partial.

table-layout.used: Bounded automatic or fixed logical-axis grid allocation with native cells and physical border segments. Complex vertical baseline/height distribution remains partial; no pagination or full WPT claim.

border-collapse.used: Separate cell borders or shared collapsed edges resolved by hidden/width/style/origin/source precedence. No paged fragments.

border-spacing.parser: One or two nonnegative lengths; percentages rejected.
border-spacing.used: Horizontal/vertical separate-border gaps including outer gaps; ignored in collapse.

caption-side.used: Captions at logical block start/end of the native table wrapper. Inline-start/end keyword grammar and advanced vertical caption constraints remain absent.

empty-cells.used: Suppresses empty cell background/border only in separate-border model.

grid-tracks.parser: Finite fixed/percentage/auto/min-content/max-content/fr, minmax, fit-content, line names, positive integer repeat and fixed auto-fill/auto-fit. No subgrid/masonry, nested repeat or grid/grid-template shorthands.
grid-tracks.cascade: Non-inherited; wide/var/rollback; invalid declarations rejected atomically.
grid-tracks.computed: Logical inline/block track lists and retained percentages.
grid-tracks.used: Bounded explicit/implicit tracks, placement, spanning growth and flexible allocation. Vertical grids allocate logical geometry and reflow native children, with at most four feedback passes. 256 tracks/axis; no full WPT gate.

grid-areas.parser: Rectangular equal-width quoted rows and none; nonrectangular named areas rejected.
grid-areas.used: Explicit area extent and generated name-start/name-end lines; grid-area placement.

grid-line.parser: auto, nonzero lexical signed integer, custom line/area name and positive span with optional name; grid-row/column/area atomically expand.
grid-line.computed: Typed line/span; negative explicit-grid indexing retained.
grid-line.used: Order-modified explicit and auto placement with overlapping explicit areas and bounded implicit extension. Anchored named spans search matching lines; unanchored named spans diagnose an integer-span fallback. Positioned children never occupy cells or contribute sizing.

grid-flow.parser: row/column with optional dense, or dense.
grid-flow.used: Phased locked-axis placement followed by sparse cursor or dense hole filling; capped occupancy searches report diagnostics.

flex-direction.parser: row, row-reverse, column, column-reverse; flex-flow resets direction and wrap atomically.
flex-direction.used: Order-modified flex lines, RTL/reversed axes and native orthogonal children; vertical allocation uses bounded intrinsic feedback. No external WPT claim.

flex-wrap.used: Hypothetical outer-size line collection with internal gaps, reversed cross axis; no visibility:collapse struts or fragmentation.

flex-number.parser: Finite nonnegative numbers; numeric math and exceptional values absent.
flex-number.used: CSS flexible length freezing, scaled shrink and sums below one; no animation or external WPT conformance claim.

flex-basis.parser: auto, content, finite nonnegative length/percentage/math, min-content, max-content, fit-content and fit-content(length-percentage). flex supports none/auto, numeric factors and basis.
flex-basis.computed: Typed intrinsic values, contextual lengths and retained percentages.
flex-basis.used: Shared selected-font intrinsic measurement, preferred ratio transfer, automatic main minimum and logical-axis freeze iterations. Vertical/orthogonal measurement uses bounded feedback; complex intrinsic cycles remain partial. Published ideal algorithm, not full web-compatible intrinsic sizing.

flex-size.parser: Min auto, max none, finite nonnegative length/percentage/math and intrinsic min-content/max-content/fit-content keyword or function; stretch, anchor-size and calc-size absent.
flex-size.computed: Typed physical intrinsic/length bounds; percentages retained.
flex-size.used: Shared block, inline-atomic/replaced, positioned, flex, grid, table and native-axis bounds; replaced ratio-conserving constraints where possible. Indefinite percentage bounds diagnose automatic fallback; advanced cyclic intrinsic sizing and external WPT conformance remain partial.

order.parser: Signed 32-bit lexical integer; integer math absent.
order.used: Stable order-modified flex layout and paint/hit order; no grid and no keyboard navigation implementation.

flex-align.parser: normal/auto/stretch, first/last baseline, flex/start/end/self-start/self-end/center, applicable left/right, distribution, safe/unsafe and atomic place-items/self/content. Standalone justify-items legacy initial normalizes to normal; legacy groups absent.
flex-align.cascade: Non-inherited; wide/var/rollback; place-content baseline defaults justify-content to start.
flex-align.computed: Keyword and safety flag in logical axes.
flex-align.used: Flex/grid margins, safe overflow clamps, distribution, stretch and native reflow; separate horizontal first/last baseline groups. Block align-content supports positional whole-content placement; horizontal block justify-self/items supports positional intrinsic sizing, auto-margin precedence and RTL/physical sides. Native block self-alignment and column/inline-axis/content baseline groups use diagnosed fallback; vertical allocation still uses synthesized measurement baselines. No full Align/WPT claim.

flex-gap.parser: normal or finite nonnegative length/percentage/math; gap atomically expands row/column.
flex-gap.used: Flex item/line and grid track gutters, definite percentages, zero cyclic intrinsic contribution with diagnostic. Cyclic grid row gaps resolve once against the intrinsic height without feeding overflow back into sizing. No multicolumn.

overflow.parser: visible, hidden, clip, scroll and auto; one/two physical-axis shorthand keywords and overflow-inline/block. overflow-clip-margin absent.
overflow.cascade: Logical/physical axes compete after writing-mode mapping; atomic shorthand, CSS-wide/var/rollback.
overflow.computed: Coupled visible/clip axes normalize against the opposite axis.
overflow.used: Padding-edge and transformed plane clips, glyph ink extents and document-owned bounded offsets; vertical-rl uses negative X ranges, reverse inline flow may use negative Y. Shared sticky/snap/overscroll and styled overlay input. Ordinary non-replaced inline clips, reserved gutters and external WPT gate remain absent.

position.parser: static, relative, sticky, absolute and fixed; anchors absent.
position.used: Physical CSS2 equations with native horizontal/vertical children, containing blocks, relative translations, flex/grid static areas and viewport-fixed space. Sticky keeps normal flow/margins and derives shared spatial translations at current root/nested offsets, effective insets and containing-block limits. Complex orthogonal inline static positions remain partial; no paged media or WPT gate.

inset.parser: auto or finite signed length/percentage/math; physical and logical side/pair shorthands; anchors absent.
inset.cascade: Logical and physical sides share priority, variables, CSS-wide and rollback buckets.
inset.computed: Typed length-or-auto; contextual units computed, percentages retained.
inset.used: Logical sides map to physical relative/absolute/fixed equations, opposing insets and auto margins. Indefinite percentage sizes, intrinsic cycles and complex static-position edge cases remain partial.

z-index.parser: auto or signed 32-bit lexical integer; integer math and exceptional values absent.
z-index.computed: Auto distinct from integer zero; static flex items accept integer context levels, other static boxes ignore them.
z-index.used: Root, positioned and flex-item integer contexts are atomic; CSS2 Appendix E phases with flex order-modified atomic item painting, escaped auto descendants, negative/zero/positive levels and source-order ties. Floats and future context-creating effects absent; fixed auto follows CSS2 rather than modern unconditional contexts.

white-space.parser: normal, nowrap, pre, pre-wrap, pre-line, break-spaces or supported collapse/wrap pairs; trimming, discard and preserve-spaces rejected.
white-space.cascade: Atomic longhands with CSS-wide, var, inheritance and rollback.
white-space.used: UAX14 on logical text, resolved-level shaping, logical line fitting then UAX9 L1/L2 visual order in horizontal/vertical axes. Protected clusters, paragraph breaks, trailing trim/hang and tabs. Dictionary/advanced Text4 tailoring absent.

white-space-collapse.parser: collapse, preserve, preserve-breaks and break-spaces; discard and preserve-spaces rejected.
white-space-collapse.used: Cross-node collapse, preserved geometry and trailing trim/hang before bidi line reordering. Conservative Han/Kana segment-break deletion; advanced language/script/font tailoring absent.

text-wrap-mode.used: Logical UAX14 greedy fitting in the available inline axis; forced breaks override nowrap; bidi visual order follows line fitting. No break-all, overflow-wrap or hyphenation dictionaries.

text-fill.parser: Existing finite Color 4/5 subset; no quirky hex colors, stroking or advanced color gaps resolved.
text-fill.cascade: Inherited currentcolor and wide/var/origin/layer tests; no external conformance gate.
text-fill.computed: Currentcolor is retained for inheritance; authoritative resolved fill is independent of color/borders/background.
text-fill.used: Baseline-positioned indexed glyphs for text, generated text, list markers and image alt text; selected/fallback static and variable outlines, COLR v0 palette layers and bounded PNG CBDT/sbix strikes compose in the sRGB framebuffer. Palette colors remain independent of CSS fill; no strokes, COLR v1 or SVG-font execution.

box-sizing.parser: content-box and border-box, including the exact WHATWG -webkit-box-sizing legacy alias.
box-sizing.cascade: Alias shares canonical identity, priority, var and rollback; local tests only.
box-sizing.computed: Specified keyword; no animation or full CSSOM.
box-sizing.used: Shared physical/logical used sizes and bounds across formatting contexts. Ratio-only preferred CSS ratios use the sizing box; auto-ratio and natural replaced ratios use content dimensions. Flex bases ignore the content zero floor before hypothetical clamping; advanced cyclic/fragmented sizing remains partial.

content.parser: normal, none, strings, untyped attr(name), counter(name[,style]) and counters(name,separator[,style]); images, quotes, alt text and element() absent.
content.cascade: Before/after text and marker content, including scoped CSS counters and conditional/layer/import counter styles; no page-margin/replacement model.
content.computed: Generated strings computed once in DOM/pseudo order with byte/work limits; typed attr() and full content computation absent.
content.used: Generated text participates in production shaping, transforms, native writing axes and paragraph bidi with originating identity. Relayout does not advance counters; generated content images/page margins absent.

color.parser: Finite Color 4/5 subset; no device-cmyk(), light-dark(), contrast-color(), custom profiles or exceptional numbers.
color.cascade: Local origin/layer/var/currentcolor tests; no external conformance gate.
color.computed: System colors use a fixed light palette; dependency/serialization and exceptional-value gates remain.
color.used: sRGB byte framebuffer; no HDR or CSS perceptual gamut mapping.

border-color.parser: Finite Color 4/5 subset; border image-1D alternative, advanced Color 5 and exceptional numbers absent.
border-color.cascade: Local edge/origin/layer/var/currentcolor tests; no external conformance gate.
border-color.computed: Color only, no one-dimensional image function; fixed light system palette and incomplete CSSOM.
border-color.used: sRGB byte framebuffer and basic box edges; no HDR, perceptual gamut mapping or border gradients.

image.parser: Only none; image functions, URLs and multiple layers absent.
image.cascade: Single stored value; no layered image model.

display.parser: Typed block/inline outer with flow/flow-root/flex/grid/table inner and optional flow/flow-root list-item, unordered multi-keyword grammar, legacy inline aliases, contents/none and CSS2 table-internal/caption values. Invalid combinations reject atomically; run-in/ruby/math absent.
display.cascade: Wide/var/rollback; flex/grid-item, float and positioned blockification retain canonical outer/inner combinations.
display.computed: Canonical enum exposes typed outside/inside and list-item components. Full inlinification and advanced list marker behavior remain partial.
display.used: Contents flattens before anonymous/item/table fixup, preserving DOM inheritance and real text/link/pseudo identity without decoration, overflow or positioned containing block. Replaced contents is none. Flow-root creates a float-containing BFC and inline flow-root is atomic. Existing table bounds persist; no fragmentation or external WPT claim.

direction.cascade: Inherited, CSS-wide/var/rollback; excluded from all. HTML dir=auto supplies a first-strong hint while skipping independent directional subtrees.
direction.computed: Typed direction resolved before logical property mapping; upright vertical text uses LTR.
direction.used: UAX9 paragraph base, shaping run levels, line alignment, logical edges, flex/grid reversals and scroll origins. No full HTML editing-direction or external WPT gate.

text-align-all.parser: left, right, center, start, end and justify; strings, justify-all and match-parent deferred.
text-align-all.computed: Logical keywords use paragraph direction, including plaintext.
text-align-all.used: Horizontal/vertical visual line alignment after bidi reordering; finite inter-word/inter-character justification excludes the last/br-ended line unless independently selected. No full CSS Text gate.

text-align-last.parser: auto, left, right, center, start, end and justify.
text-align-last.cascade: Inherited, reset atomically by text-align; CSS-wide/var handling.
text-align-last.used: Last/br-ended lines select independent alignment/justification; auto uses start for justified paragraphs and otherwise follows text-align-all. No script-specific expansion or full CSS Text gate.

text-align.parser: left, right, center, start, end and justify; match-parent, justify-all and advanced alignment groups absent.
text-align.cascade: Atomic text-align-all and text-align-last reset, including var and CSS-wide.
text-align.used: Visual line alignment and finite inter-word/inter-character selected-line justification in native writing axes, with per-line UAX9 ordering and independent last-line alignment. Advanced script expansion and full Text4 conformance absent.

alignment-baseline.computed: Table alignment keyword; no alternative script baseline metrics.
alignment-baseline.used: Selected/fallback faces share the alphabetic baseline; table-cell middle alignment uses allocated row height. Non-baseline inline alignment diagnoses baseline fallback.

baseline-shift.parser: Only numeric zero; lengths, percentages and shift keywords deferred.
baseline-shift.used: No baseline shift; advanced vertical alignment deferred.

baseline-source.used: Replaced images use the bottom margin edge; atomic inline-flex/grid export first item baselines and inline-table exports its first row baseline excluding captions. First/last selection remains partial.

vertical-align.parser: baseline, top, middle and bottom; offsets, sub/super and first/last deferred.
vertical-align.cascade: Atomically expands and resets the three pinned-spec longhands, including CSS-wide and variables.
vertical-align.computed: Physical table-cell alignment, zero shift and auto source.
vertical-align.used: Table cells align baseline/top/middle/bottom within allocated row/span height. Non-baseline inline alignment explicitly diagnoses a baseline fallback; advanced metrics absent.

font-size.parser: Finite lengths/math/size keywords; math keyword and additional Values 4/5 forms absent.
font-size.cascade: Local inheritance/var/origin tests; no external conformance gate.
font-size.computed: UA medium=16px; 512 CSS px cap; selected-face ch/ex/cap/ic and corresponding root metrics.
font-size.used: Shared selected-face OpenType shaping and exact indexed raster scale; no full browser font parity.

font-family.parser: Family lists/generic names; no complete CSSOM serialization gate.
font-family.cascade: Inherited list selects the same document font context used by layout/paint and contextual units.
font-family.computed: UA initial is sans-serif; typed list retained.
font-family.used: Document-owned @font-face aliases, numeric weight/range descriptors, unicode ranges and TTF/OTF/WOFF/WOFF2 sources precede installed fontdb families. Indexed shaping and static/variable TrueType/CFF2 outline raster share clamped axis settings; COLR v0 and bounded PNG bitmap strikes paint real color glyphs. Conditional resources are separate from relayout. Specialized generics approximate sans-serif; timed font-display, collection downloads, COLR v1/SVG and advanced descriptors remain partial/unsupported.

font-weight.parser: Numbers 1..1000, normal/bold/bolder/lighter and finite number math.
font-weight.cascade: Local relative/inherited tests; no external conformance gate.
font-weight.computed: Local relative-weight rules; no exhaustive external tests.
font-weight.used: Numeric/range @font-face matching with CSS asymmetric weight search, or installed fontdb matching; actual wght axis coordinates are shared by shaping and raster and explicit variation settings override automatic axes. Synthetic bold applies only when no actual heavy face/coordinate satisfies the request.

font-style.parser: Only normal, italic, oblique; no oblique angle or left/right.
font-style.cascade: Local inherited tests; no external conformance gate.
font-style.used: Document @font-face normal/italic/oblique descriptors and installed fontdb face matching; synthesize slant only when the actual selected/fallback face is upright. Oblique-angle descriptors unsupported.

line-height.parser: Finite nonnegative number/length/percentage/math and normal subset.
line-height.cascade: Local inherited tests; no external conformance gate.
line-height.computed: Normal retained; lh/rlh use selected-face line metrics.
line-height.used: Primary struts and actual fallback runs contribute ascent/descent and signed half-leading, including zero/negative leading and glyph overflow. No advanced vertical alignment.

size.parser: auto, finite nonnegative length/percentage/math, min-content, max-content, fit-content and fit-content(length-percentage); stretch/anchor-size/calc-size absent.
size.computed: Typed intrinsic values survive with length/percentage/math into layout.
size.used: Shared production shaping/legal-break and flex/grid/table/replaced intrinsic measurement, min/max and preferred ratios across block, atomic inline, absolute/fixed and native writing axes. Indefinite percentage-height/bounds and cyclic fit limits diagnose fallback. Finite local exact reftests, not full cyclic CSS Sizing/WPT conformance.

container-type.parser: Only normal, size, inline-size; scroll-state and combinations absent.
container-type.cascade: Named/anonymous queries and var; no external conformance gate.
container-type.used: Writing-mode-aware physical/logical size eligibility and per-container cqi/cqb resolution; bounded frame feedback. Vertical auto-size containment and advanced formatting contexts remain partial.

container-name.parser: none or bounded custom-ident list (256 tokens); no external grammar gate.
container-name.cascade: Name/inheritance/query handling; no external conformance gate.
container-name.used: Named size containers with individual writing-axis eligibility.

margin.parser: Auto and finite lengths/percentages/math; physical/logical sides and pair shorthands; anchors absent.
margin.cascade: Logical and physical candidates share cascade priority, var, explicit logical inherit and rollback.
margin.computed: Auto and percentages retained separately from used values.
margin.used: Physical CSS2 equations, horizontal adjoining sets, parallel vertical sibling collapse, native flex/grid/orthogonal children and positioned equations. Percent decorations use the containing inline axis. Vertical parent/empty collapse and full sizing conformance remain partial.

padding.parser: Finite nonnegative lengths/percentages/math, physical/logical sides and pair shorthands.
padding.computed: Typed lengths; percentages retained until containing inline-axis resolution.
padding.used: Native block/replaced/orthogonal boxes and sliced visual inline fragments. Non-replaced block-axis decorations do not enlarge lines. Full percentage-cycle and WPT gates remain absent.

border-width.parser: Finite nonnegative lengths and thin/medium/thick; hairline and additional Values forms absent.
border-width.cascade: Local side/four-value/wide tests; no external conformance gate.
border-width.computed: UA widths 1/3/5px; none/hidden zeroing, no spec snapping gate.
border-width.used: Block/replaced edges and per-line inline edge slicing; non-replaced vertical borders do not enlarge lines. No advanced border geometry.

border-style.cascade: Local side/four-value/wide tests; no external conformance gate.
border-style.used: Basic edge paint; no full border-style conformance gate.

all.parser: Five existing CSS-wide keywords only; snapshot revert-rule absent.
all.cascade: Expands only implemented longhands; does not implement snapshot's unsupported properties.
all.used: Only supported property's finite layout/paint subset.

background.parser: One color and/or none; layers, sizing, positioning, repeat, attachment and boxes absent.
background.cascade: Resets only supported background-color/image; other longhand and reset targets absent.
background.computed: Only color and None image stored.

font.parser: Finite style/weight/size/line-height/family subset; variants, width and system-font shorthand components absent.
font.cascade: Sets the five parsed fields and resets all newly supported font longhand/reset targets to generated initials; unsupported spec targets remain absent.
font.used: Document-owned web fonts over shared system/bundled discovery, indexed shaping, real variable TrueType/CFF2 and finite color/bitmap font raster. Advanced descriptors/timed font-display, COLR v1 and SVG remain unsupported/partial.

container.parser: Names with optional size/inline-size/normal type; scroll-state absent.
container.cascade: Resets both supported fields; local tests only.
container.used: Bounded frame feedback and writing-axis-aware container snapshots; advanced auto-size containment remains partial.

border.parser: Finite width/style/color subset; hairline, groove/ridge/inset/outset and additional colors absent.
border.cascade: Supported physical edges only; border-image reset targets absent.
border.used: Basic box edges only; no full border paint conformance.
